lessons.title: Group Roles — Why Pretty Ricky Worked

body.text: Goals: Teach group architecture. Break it down: Pleasure P – the true vocalist Smooth tone, real R&B chops, emotional center. Spectacular – the hype-man dancer Persona, performance energy. Baby Blue – the rapper/MC Gave the group that hood-stamp authenticity. Slick’Em – ad-libs + flavor Light bars, comedic timing. Teach your son: “Every group needs balance — voices, energy, flavor, and identity.” Have him identify who’s singing vs talking vs rapping in each song.

body.text: Goals: Teach theme literacy (for older age). Important lessons: Play (when older): Discuss maturity vs immaturity in love themes.

Pretty Ricky leaned into playfulness + romance

They made sex conversations normal for R&B of the 2000s
Vulnerability under raunchiness: wanting connection, not just lust

body.text: This adapted checkpoint brings the unit overview and influence threads together.
